confirmedItems: All eleven candidate files were copied byte-identically into reviewed-subject; all JSON candidate documents parse and the HTML parses as a document.

The proposed manifest contains ten non-self entries; all ten declared digests recompute and match. The manifest digest is recomputed as 2184986970076bb5317c31459e335d1e9272973411c3e3d14a1886102b07214a before and after review.
Model-plan revision 111 recomputes to 64861f18c47c3eaa42cbe71af2e4cc158a5abfe02843fcb6784456a6cb2db9e7 and the author actual runtime is gpt-5.6-sol.
Reviewer actual runtime is gpt-5.6-luna and differs from the author actual runtime; independence is verified.
Markdown and HTML headings match 13/13; HTML has no external script source and includes responsive/print styling.
The candidate retains explicit no-deployment, no-approval, no-certification, no-specific-processing-region and blocked-promotion boundaries.
Fixed model IDs, versions, interfaces, API versions, capability fields, route allow-lists, owner-bound capacity, fail-closed substitution and human authority are present.

findings.title: Security evaluation scenarios are not explicitly blocking promotion criteria
findings.impact: Prompt-injection, poisoned-evidence, cross-case, filter-override, mismatch, fallback and autonomous-authority scenarios are listed and measured, but no explicit pass/fail threshold or blocking promotion gate binds them. The security contract calls these tests promotion gates, so the candidate contracts are not internally aligned on whether failed or absent security results block promotion.
findings.requiredAction: Add explicit blocking security-evaluation gates with required pass criteria, evidence IDs and fail-closed handling for every listed security scenario; bind the same criteria in the evaluation, routing and security contracts before promotion.

findings.title: EU Data Zone and two-region recovery semantics are not concretely bound
findings.impact: The overlay says the two-region recovery pattern remains unchanged and makes primary/recovery regions an owner input, but it does not state how each tier is deployed or recovered, whether both recovery resources are EU-approved DataZoneStandard deployments, how failover preserves the prompt/output and at-rest boundaries, or what exact fail-closed rule applies when the recovery deployment/provider evidence is absent. The change-control specification expressly requires reconciliation with the two-region recovery design.
findings.owner: AFF-3 / Azure Platform / General Counsel / DPO / CISO / AI Governance
findings.requiredAction: Define the primary/recovery deployment and failover semantics for all GPT and embedding routes, approved geography and resource allow-list evidence, data/log/index/backup handling, provider-selected processing-region boundary, and deny/queue behaviour when recovery evidence is missing; bind these as testable contract fields.

findings.title: Material source claims lack precise, claim-bound traceability
findings.impact: The new contracts provide bare URLs but no source IDs, sections, retrieval dates, supporting excerpts or claim-to-source bindings for the material model availability, API/interface, capability-limit, Data Zone, privacy and networking assertions. The existing Phase 3 source register is not extended by the CC-002 candidate, so the cited URLs are not precise enough to audit the assertions they are intended to support.
findings.owner: AFF-3 / AI Governance / General Counsel / DPO / CISO
findings.requiredAction: Add a CC-002 source-binding record (or equivalent fields) with claim IDs, exact URL and section, retrieval date, supporting evidence excerpt/hash and disposition for every material provider/model/sovereignty/security assertion; bind it into the candidate manifest and change-control evidence.

findings.title: HTML does not reproduce every substantive Markdown table row
findings.impact: Headings match 13/13, but Markdown has separate Explainable anomaly challenger and Supervised prediction rows with distinct governance boundaries; HTML merges them into Anomaly challengers and omits the explicit governed gradient-boosted and labelled-outcome condition. Several table labels and cells are paraphrased rather than reproduced.
findings.requiredAction: Regenerate the HTML companion so every substantive Markdown table row and decision is represented without omission; regenerate the candidate manifest afterwards.

verdictRationale: Three unresolved MAJOR subject defects prevent a conforming review: security evaluation outcomes are not explicit blocking promotion criteria, the Data Zone/recovery relationship is not concretely bound, and material source claims are not precisely claim-bound. A MINOR Markdown/HTML parity defect is also open. The candidate cannot proceed to convergence or human approval unchanged.
residualGaps: Owner-bound region, capacity, quota, reasoning, benchmark, provider, retention and classification inputs remain unresolved and fail closed.
AFF-B review and explicit human approval remain pending.
requiredAction: Do not approve or promote this candidate. Preserve this immutable review and create an append-only CC-002 remediation revision with a new manifest, then re-run complete AFF-A/AFF-B review against unchanged bytes. Do not edit this candidate or this review.
nonApprovalStatement: AFF-A does not approve, certify, waive, deploy, perform Azure validation, perform runtime testing or substitute for the human architect.
